content: Hash-chained append-only audit pattern: entry_hash = SHA256(prev_hash || canonical_payload); genesis prev_hash = 64 zeros; optionally HMAC-SHA256 with a seal key kept off-log; per-record sequence numbers; an anchor/checkpoint (head hash + count) to detect tail truncation; SQLite enforcement via BEFORE UPDATE/DELETE triggers RAISE(ABORT), WAL, busy_timeout. Reference libs: auditchain (MIT, sqlite/jsonl, async, checkpoints), sealog, nexuscone. For DRY/SOLID a ~40-line in-house module (hashlib/hmac/sqlite3) is preferable.
